title: Project: Abandoned GUI Pack
description: I made this quick GUI Pack to replace the Main Menu's Minecraft logo with my Project: Abandoned one which is my Minecraft server, hope you enjoy! and it also changes the XP Bar and the Hearts to fit the Theme
body:
![MCPA](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e51ee60de4ddaa243ce0e66b478796c8d3e03b8.png)

**Minecraft: Project Abandoned** is a GUI Texture Pack that changes the look of the Main Menu's Minecraft logo to my custom Project Abandoned one, just to kinda expand my Minecraft Server to be more a Server
